jobs.occupation: Electronics Design Engineer (m/f/x) (Elektroniker/in - Informations- und Telekommunikationstechnik)
jobs.description:
At go-e, we have been pursuing the development of our vision with passion and strength from the very beginning. We are moving in an area that is characterized by breakthroughs and growth and that requires a lot of personal responsibility and creative solution finding. On our journey towards the energy transition, the mixture of innovation and security, regional and international, self-realization and professionalism is the ideal fuel for our mutual growth.

Our products:

-Incorporate high-speed embedded hardware as well as high power circuitry - providing a smart interconnection of power sources to electrical cars for charging purposes
-Satisfy high quality needs in terms of user friendliness and versatile application
-Provide an ecosystem for EV users making them independent from grid charges 

With your contribution, you will impact how people will charge their cars in the future. Come and join the team that is building the future of innovative charger solutions for e-mobility!

Your area of responsibility

- Transformation of high-level product ideas into hardware concepts - together with product owners, software and mechanical design engineers 
- Conception of complete devices in tight collaboration with product owners, software and mechanical design engineers 
- Development and simulation of circuit and PCB design as essential core of the devices using EDA tools
- Initial operation and verification of circuitry - with documentation of performance results
- Integration of the device in close collaboration with the software team
- Creation of test plans for PCBA and device manufacturing 
- Provision of full documentation set for PCBA manufacturing (Gerber, etc.)
- Maintenance for devices in the field (discontinued parts, etc.)

It would be great if you have

- At least 3 years of professional experience in the field
- University degree in electronic/electrical engineering or similar education (technician, dual education, etc.)
- Significant professional experience with Altium designer or another EDA tool
- Basic knowledge of digital circuit design/principles
- Experience with the design of analog circuits
- Familiarity with populating a PCB and using lab equipment 
- Empathy towards your colleagues with a collaborative mindset
- Ability to work with little oversight and independent decision-making
- Fluency in spoken and written English

It would be even better if you have

- Familiarity with the concepts of EMC and EMI
- Experience with HDI PCB Design
- Experience with cellular basebands and smartphone SoCs
- Experience with SI/PI Simulation or willingness to learn
- Experience with Keysight ADS

What we offer

- Be one of the key drivers of our core technologies
- A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects
- Flexible working hours
- Mental well-being support
- Employee discounts on our products
- Corporate discounts on a variety of brands

About go-e
We are a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility and have developed from a start-up to an internationally recognized player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, Austria, we have already expanded to around 20 European countries. With bold ideas based on our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies today.

jobs.occupation: Portfolio & Go-to-Market Manager – Energy Management (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
The energy transition is happening now. Help us lead it.

The energy transition is one of the defining challenges of our time. And for commercial and industrial customers, the question is no longer whether to transform — it is how, and how fast.

At Siemens, we are right at the heart of that answer. Through our ONE Tech Company approach, we are aligning our energy management portfolio across businesses to deliver solutions that are smarter, more integrated, and built for what is coming next — not just what exists today.

We are looking for someone who gets excited by that challenge. Someone who can bridge technology and market strategy, connect the dots across a complex organization, and drive real impact — for our customers and for Siemens.

Sounds like you? Read on.

What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- Barrier-free locations

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

Your week will span three perspectives:

- Customer & Market Intelligence- Engage directly with C&I customers to understand challenges and validate portfolio relevance.- Gather market and competitor intelligence to keep Siemens sharp and ahead of the curve.- Monitor AI and emerging technologies and translate relevant trends into actionable recommendations for portfolio and Go-to-Market strategy.- Explore and pilot new business models that go beyond today's existing portfolio.
- Strategy & Portfolio- Shape and align the Go-to-Market strategy for ONE Tech Company Energy Management, including target sales motions and business models.- Drive portfolio transparency across Siemens Energy Management offerings, identify capability gaps, and define actions to meet evolving customer demands.- Leverage technical synergies and guide future portfolio evolution to maximise customer value and business impact.
- Execution & Alignment- Drive joint Go-to-Market initiatives across Smart Infrastructure, Digital Industries and other Siemens businesses.- Navigate and align stakeholders across multiple businesses — building consensus in complexity.- Establish the right operating model for a winning Energy Management go-to-market.

What you should be able to do. So that the world can do more.

- Education- Master's degree in electrical engineering, business administration, digital business management, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Experience & Skills:- Longterm experience managing a diverse portfolio of hardware, software, and digital services, with a proven track record in developing and selling digital services within a B2B environment.- Understanding of market trends and offerings in commercial and industrial energy solutions, microgrids, and energy efficiency. Demonstrated ability to define and execute successful Go-to-Market strategies.- Awareness of how AI and emerging technologies are reshaping energy management, with the ability to translate these trends into portfolio and Go-to-Market decisions.- Experience applying AI-driven insights to portfolio strategy or Go-to-Market planning is a strong differentiator.- Ability to identify and pursue opportunities beyond existing portfolio boundaries, transforming market insights into actionable initiatives.
- Ways of working- Working backwards from C&I customer needs in Energy Management, challenging the status quo, and leveraging your experience with latest go-to-market approaches and respective commercial models.- Proven experience working across multiple businesses or divisions, building bridges, driving alignment, and thriving in interdisciplinary teams with global colleagues and customers.- Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, bringing structure, driving clarity, and moving forward proactively. You take initiative, contribute your own ideas, and aren't afraid to put them into practice.- Long-term experience within large corporations is a plus.
- Languages: Fluent in English and conversational in German; additional languages are a plus.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
The transition to a sustainable, carbon-neutral future is reshaping the energy, building, and industrial process industries at an unprecedented pace. Renewable energy, storage solutions, and the accelerating electrification of transport and industrial processes are placing new and complex demands on the power grids of tomorrow.
As ONE Tech Company, Siemens is more than the sum of its parts — and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition. jobs.occupation: Sales Director (f/m/d) Test & Validation - DACH (Leiter/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Engineering Test & Validation

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation - helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Our Testing business sits at the heart of this transformation. As products become more software-defined, connected, electrified, and complex, manufacturers need to bring together physical testing, data acquisition, simulation, analysis, and engineering software into a connected validation process.
This creates a significant growth opportunity - and we are looking for an exceptional commercial leader to lead it across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).

The Opportunity
As Test Country Lead (w/m/d) DACH, you will own the commercial success and growth of the Siemens Test business across the region.
You will lead the Sales and PreSales organization while remaining highly visible in the market and directly engaged with strategic customers. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will build and develop a high-performing organization while personally shaping major opportunities, executive relationships, and strategic accounts.
You will spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.
This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.
What you will ownLead the DACH Test Business

- Own the overall commercial performance of the Test business across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.- Drive revenue, growth, profitability, and market-share objectives across hardware, software, maintenance, and customer & engineering services.- Define and execute the regional business strategy and annual operating plan.- Identify new growth opportunities, markets, customers, and routes to market.- Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs, and accountability across the organization.

Lead from the Market- Personally engage with strategic customers and executive stakeholders, building trusted relationships at C-level and senior engineering levels.- Lead major strategic sales pursuits and complex, multi-year opportunities.- Develop compelling value propositions and quantified business cases that connect technology investment to measurable customer outcomes.- Understand customer engineering and validation challenges and translate them into differentiated Siemens solutions.- Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, competitor strategies, technology shifts, and emerging customer requirements.- Represent Siemens Test at customer events, industry conferences, and executive forums.

Connect Customers with Siemens Technology

- Work closely with global Product Management, Industry, Engineering, and Services teams to bring the right solutions to customers.- Ensure that customer feedback and market intelligence directly influence regional and global strategy.- Drive adoption of the broader Siemens portfolio by connecting test, measurement, simulation, engineering software, and services into compelling customer solutions.- Ensure operational excellence through accurate forecasting, disciplined opportunity management, reliable demonstrations, and measurable sales performance.

We are looking for an accomplished Sales Director, Business Leader, or Commercial Leader who combines strong sales leadership with a deep understanding of engineering-driven technology markets, especially in test & validation.

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across many countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on executive to lead our global Research & Development and Technology organization. In this role, you will combine the operational leadership of a large, globally distributed R&D organization with the strategic responsibility for the technology roadmap of Siemens Electrical Products. **Technology and Portfolio Development  ** - Shape the future portfolio by further developing the electromechanical product foundation while expanding power-electronics- and semiconductor-based solutions, advancing direct-current architectures, and enabling connected, software-supported products.   - Advance the secure connectivity and IoT strategy and evaluate how data management and artificial intelligence can create measurable customer and product value.   - Lead the evolution toward increasingly connected, intelligent, and updatable products by integrating electronics, communication, software, cybersecurity, and cloud capabilities into a strong electromechanical product portfolio, while ensuring quality and regulatory compliance.   - Embed sustainability into engineering and product decisions by advancing circular and repairable design, eco-design, material efficiency, lower losses, and a reduced product carbon footprint.

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Operational support for the Pilot Synthetic Training System (PSTS) project regarding integration and operational acceptance test
- Performance of operational tests in the Eurofighter cockpit and Instructor Operator Station
- Operational support for PSTS operational tests (Air/Air, Air/Surface)
- Operational support for national and international PSTS rollout activities

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the team “System Support Engineering“, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Logistic Support Analysis Engineer Eurodrone (d/f/m) In this role, you are not just an analyst, but you actively shape the Technical Data for our programs. You help ensure that complex engineering data is transformed into clear and efficient maintenance instructions. We are looking for someone who speaks the language of technicians and understands the structure behind the data. This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks. Your location Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach. Our Benefits for You Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. Your tasks and responsibilities Building the Bridge between Design and Documentation LSA & Editing: You perform analyses (S3000L) and form the technical basis for our manuals and catalogs. Early Influence: You work closely with the Design Office to optimize the maintainability and documentation capability of new modifications as early as the design phase. Production Management: Establishing / monitoring KPIs for LSA activities and proposing improvements in close collaboration with engineering and suppliers. Digitalization: You drive the application of modern standards and contribute to the modernization of our editorial processes. Experience in Export Control Classification is required Desired skills and qualifications Technical Know-how meets Editorial Skill In-house Experience: You hold a degree in a technical field or a comparable qualification and are already familiar with our aircraft systems from practical experience. Work experience: You have many years of professional experience in the mentioned work environment. Interest in Documentation: You enjoy precise technical analysis and the preparation of technical content according to current standards (LSA standards, ASD specifications). Mindset: You work in a structured manner, are proactive in coordinating with interface partners, and are eager to dive deep into new systems (avionics, hydraulics, autopilot, etc.). Language Skills: Your German and English is fluent for working in international programs. Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.
